newsitem.title: USA: Time Inc sees 96 oper income $530 mln - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Time Inc sees 96 oper income $530 mln - NYT.

text.p: Time Warner's Time Inc unit expects to earn more than $530 million in operating income for 1996 on revenues of more than $4 billion, the New York Times said on Monday.
Time Warner Chief Executive Gerald Levin told the paper in an interview that the return on capital at Time Inc is higher than those at any of the company's other businesses.
The article said Time Inc, whose magazines include Money, Sports Illustrated, Time and People, is thriving even though parent company Time Warner continues to struggle with debt.
Wall Street expects Time Warner to post a loss of $0.10 per share for the fourth quarter and a loss of $1.11 for the full year, according to First Call estimates.
